## Phillips 66 (PSX) `[Energy & Refining]`
- Shares were cited among refiners that fell after reports that the White House was preparing a **90-day diesel-export ban** amid record fuel prices; the report did not identify a Phillips 66-specific announcement. (eOption)
- WTI crude settled at **$92.16 per barrel**, up **$1.64**, while the 10-year Treasury yield reached **5.11%** during the session. (eOption)

## Cloudflare, Inc. (NET) `[Software & SaaS]`
- **No company-specific catalyst found in window.**
- Cloudflare was included in a September 23 Zacks feature highlighting **Cloudflare, NVIDIA, Meta, Astera Labs, and SpaceX**; the item did not report a new filing, contract, earnings release, or analyst action for Cloudflare. (Zacks)

## Meta Platforms, Inc. (META) `[Internet & Platforms]`
- Meta held its annual **Meta Connect** event on September 23, with Mark Zuckerberg scheduled to deliver the keynote at **7:00 p.m. ET**. (eOption)
- Meta’s **Muse** AI agent had been downloaded more than **902,000 times in six days** after its September 8 introduction, according to Bloomberg. (Bloomberg)
- Shopify announced a partnership allowing Meta’s Muse AI agents to complete checkouts across Shopify’s platform. (StockStory)
- Expedia announced that Muse could access its platform to help users plan trips. (eOption)
- Morgan Stanley identified Twilio and Wix as the communications-software companies “best exposed” if Muse increased communications volumes and demand. (Morgan Stanley note via Seeking Alpha)

## Zscaler, Inc. (ZS) `[Software & SaaS]`
- **No company-specific catalyst found in window.**
- No September 23 company release, SEC filing, contract, earnings report, or named analyst action was identified in the available search results.

## Rubrik, Inc. (RBRK) `[Software & SaaS]`
- **No company-specific catalyst found in window.**
- No September 23 company release, SEC filing, contract, earnings report, or named analyst action was identified in the available search results.

## Natera, Inc. (NTRA) `[Healthcare Diagnostics]`
- Natera’s **Signatera** test received regulatory approval in Japan from the **Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency** as a companion diagnostic for **muscle-invasive bladder cancer**; the item described the approval as the catalyst for a **5.2% rise on Tuesday, September 22**, not a new September 23 catalyst. (StockStory)
- **No additional company-specific catalyst found in the September 23 window.**

## Super Micro Computer, Inc. (SMCI) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- Super Micro said it had begun shipping **NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 racks** for production deployments, incorporating Supermicro liquid cooling and data-center infrastructure. (Yahoo Finance)
- The company said it received more than **$60 billion in new orders during fiscal Q4** and entered fiscal 2027 with a record backlog. (Yahoo Finance)
- Super Micro projected fiscal 2027 revenue of **$65 billion to $72 billion**. (Yahoo Finance)
- Super Micro’s fiscal 2026 net sales reached **$39.1 billion**, versus **$22.0 billion** in the prior year. (Yahoo Finance)
- MarketBeat reported that Super Micro was expanding manufacturing capacity to produce more than **6,000 racks per month**. (MarketBeat)
- Nykredit A/S initiated a position of **121,341 shares**, valued at approximately **$3.56 million**, during the second quarter; this was disclosed through a 13F filing rather than a September 23 operating announcement. (Nykredit A/S 13F via MarketBeat)

## Circle Internet Group (CRCL) `[Fintech & Digital Assets]`
- Circle had a consensus **Hold** rating based on **12 hold, 10 buy, 4 sell, and 1 strong-buy** recommendations; the average price target was **$99.94**. (MarketBeat)
- MarketBeat reported quarterly revenue of **$701.32 million**, up **6.6% year over year**, and earnings of **$0.18 per share** versus a **$0.26 consensus estimate**; the publication did not date those results to September 23. (MarketBeat)
- CEO Jeremy Allaire sold **56,200 shares**, while reported insider sales totaled **528,386 shares** worth approximately **$40.3 million** during the quarter; these were background filing-related facts, not a new September 23 catalyst. (MarketBeat)
- Binance agreed to purchase **$100 million** of Circle shares at **$80.84 per share** and expanded its USDC partnership; the report did not identify the transaction as newly announced on September 23. (MarketBeat)
- **No September 23 company-specific catalyst found in window.**
- The available market commentary attributed the broader move to a crypto-sector risk-off session, with Bitcoin trading below **$69,000**. (Tickeron)

## Twilio Inc. (TWLO) `[Software & SaaS]`
- Rosenblatt Securities maintained a **Buy** rating and raised its price target from **$275 to $290** on September 23. (Rosenblatt Securities note via MarketBeat)
- Morgan Stanley said Twilio was among the communications-software companies “best exposed” if Meta’s Muse AI agent increased communications volumes and demand. (Morgan Stanley note via Seeking Alpha)
- Twilio had been reported at **$5.07 billion** of fiscal 2025 revenue, up **13.7% year over year**, and **$997.40 million** of free cash flow versus **$709.26 million** in fiscal 2024; these figures were background information published September 23, not a new earnings release. (Investing.com)
